summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing Next Day Disclosure Returns with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for June 23–26, 2026, as required under HK Listing Rule 13.25A. These returns disclose routine changes in issued shares due to the issuance of shares upon option exercises and RSU vesting under equity incentive plans. There are no terms concerning price, premium, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. The filing is a compliance submission regarding share capital movements, not an event-driven special situation. No transactional event or activist campaign is present, so no risk-arb angle applies.
